description: Get the base every NEW project starts from — the host shell with sign-in and the lobby (index.html, main.tsx, src/app.config.ts, the wallet files, an empty src/modules.ts, config; the lobby and sign-in come from @idosgames/app-shell). Write these files to the project root, install the versions from get_manifest, then add modules with get_module: the systems with inBase, the game(s) with the modules each game 'uses', and any other system the app needs. Read-only; takes no title_id.
name: get_host_scaffold
title: Get project scaffold
